crossRefs.note: He has put a new song in my mouth, even praise to our God. Many shall see it, and fear, and shall trust in Yahweh.
For you are my hope, Lord Yahweh, my confidence from my youth.
Israel, trust in Yahweh! He is their help and their shield.
Yahweh, my heart isn’t arrogant, nor my eyes lofty; nor do I concern myself with great matters, or things too wonderful…
Israel, hope in Yahweh, from this time forward and forever more.
But I will leave among you an afflicted and poor people, and they will take refuge in Yahweh’s name.
But there is forgiveness with you, therefore you are feared.
For you, Lord, are good, and ready to forgive, abundant in loving kindness to all those who call on you.
But you, Lord, are a merciful and gracious God, slow to anger, and abundant in loving kindness and truth.
Let the wicked forsake his way, and the unrighteous man his thoughts. Let him return to Yahweh, and he will have mercy…

For we were saved in hope, but hope that is seen is not hope. For who hopes for that which he sees?
in whom we have our redemption through his blood, the forgiveness of our trespasses, according to the riches of his…
which he made to abound toward us in all wisdom and prudence,
For there is one God, and one mediator between God and men, the man Christ Jesus,
who gave himself as a ransom for all, the testimony in its own times,
Therefore don’t throw away your boldness, which has a great reward.

people.name: Israel
people.line: Patriarch, son of Isaac, father of twelve tribes

translations.web: Israel, hope in Yahweh, for there is loving kindness with Yahweh. Abundant redemption is with him.
translations.bsb: O Israel, put your hope in the LORD, for with the LORD is loving devotion, and with Him is redemption in abundance.
translations.kjv: Let Israel hope in the LORD: for with the LORD there is mercy, and with him is plenteous redemption.
translations.asv: O Israel, hope in Jehovah; For with Jehovah there is lovingkindness, And with him is plenteous redemption.
